Scope agreed with the search lane owner (com-synexia-45): this leaf takes L-Hash v1 (tokens + logic hash), MinHash with banded LSH and the gear CDC with its per-chunk SHA-256; SimHash64 and the FNV-1a string hash stay with 45 (jdk.m3.search.M3SimHash64 / jdk.m3.search.M3Utf8Fnv1a64, landed by #2550 while this leaf ran) and with M3IndexDbChunkSimHash (tie rule pinned by #2514).

# FILE rows: donor path -> target path (module root m3/indexdb). PACKAGE: donor package -> target package. TYPE: donor type -> target type; a scope restricts the row to that target file. MEMBER/MUTANT/SUBST/EXTERNAL/DONOR_DEP: as in recipe v2 (hamming-topk-20261106), unused here. SKIP: donor file not relocated (scope = reason class NEC-45, DEFER or MACHINERY), pinned in PROVENANCE.tsv and compiled on the donor side of differential.sh when it is a main source; the recipe refuses a relocated file that still names a SKIP type. ORACLE: donor oracle script or evidence read by differential.sh/verify.sh from the donor git, pinned, never relocated. PROBE: a file outside the crate compiled only by differential.sh for an NEC probe (scope donor = donor git, m3 = this repository). NEC: a recorded difference, never an equivalence decision (donor member -> the M3 owner member it overlaps). NAMING: exact text -> the rewrite jdk_naming.py would make (rule named in the note), scoped to one FILE target, applied exactly once.
